category_description: Teaching and learning resources for UK primary schools, teachers and families (Twinkl market)
extractable: teaching-resource websites and subscription libraries (lesson plans, worksheets, PowerPoints, schemes of work)
home-learning, reading, maths and revision sites or apps for children and parents (including SATs preparation)
phonics programmes, schemes of work and curriculum providers
AI lesson-planning tools built specifically for teachers (Oak Aila, Teachmate, Diffit, MagicSchool, Kuraplan, Khanmigo)
workbook and revision-guide publishers surfaced as an option (CGP, Collins, Scholastic, Schofield & Sims)
free public, charitable or subject-association resource providers when offered as an option (Oak National Academy, BBC Bitesize, NRICH, Historical Association, BookTrust, STEM Learning)
exam boards (AQA, OCR, Pearson Edexcel) and heritage bodies (The National Archives, Historic England) when offered as a source of teaching resources
exclusions: government bodies and official guidance as such: DfE, gov.uk, Ofsted, STA, the National Curriculum, the EYFS statutory framework. Guidance documents are references, not providers.

research, evidence, advice and review bodies cited as validators or sources: EEF, NFER, Sutton Trust, Teacher Tapp, British Dyslexia Association, Dyslexia Scotland, Nasen, EdTech Impact, quality-mark schemes
social, video and community platforms: Facebook groups, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, X, Mumsnet (channels, not providers)
general-purpose AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Perplexity) named incidentally. EXCEPTION: extract one when the response explicitly shortlists it as an option for the buyer's task
generic productivity, design and office tools: Canva, Notion, Google Docs / Slides / Classroom, Microsoft Word / PowerPoint, Padlet, Trello
lesson-planner / timetable / admin software that is not a resource library or an AI lesson generator (Planbook, Chalk, Tapestry)
bare book or workbook TITLES with no publisher or brand named: extract the publisher when one is named
standalone_exclusions: worksheets, lesson plans, schemes of work, phonics, SSP, SATs, KS1, KS2, KS3, GCSE, EYFS, early years, Year 1 to Year 6, National Curriculum, curriculum, free resources, subscription, PDF, PowerPoint, editable, printable, SEND, SENCo, dyslexia, autism, home education, cover lessons, revision, past papers, workbook, planning, workload, AI
examples: Oak National Academy -> brand Oak National Academy, entity Oak National Academy
Teachmate -> brand Teachmate, entity Teachmate, entity_type ai_tool
Little Wandle -> brand Little Wandle, entity Little Wandle, entity_type programme
CGP -> brand CGP, entity CGP, entity_type publisher
about_target: Twinkl is a UK-based educational publisher of teacher-created teaching and learning resources: worksheets, PowerPoints, lesson plans, schemes of work, phonics, EYFS and SEND materials and home-learning resources, sold mainly by subscription. Only mentions of Twinkl as a teaching or learning resource provider count.
notes: Abbreviated example config from the Twinkl onboarding (the live v3 context has more mappings).
